# Drug Master File Manager Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills > Industry > Life Sciences

## Overview

Use when managing Drug Master File (DMF) submissions and maintenance including Type II DMF for drug substances, DMF authorization management, annual updates, and cross-reference management for regulatory support.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [drug-master-file-manager-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
drug-master-file-manager-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@drug-master-file-manager` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Prepare Type II DMF content with drug substance manufacturing and quality data
- Manage DMF authorization letters for ANDA/NDA/BLA cross-referencing
- Process annual DMF updates with changed information and administrative amendments
- Coordinate DMF holder and applicant communication for regulatory support

## Industry Standards Applied

- **21 CFR 314.420**: FDA Drug Master File submission and maintenance requirements
- **FDA DMF Guidance**: FDA guidance on Drug Master File procedures and content
- **ICH Q7**: GMP for active pharmaceutical ingredients in DMF content
